final:
settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["level", "color"], ["5", "red"]) == ["fast", "5", "red"]
  ex settings(["mode"], ["slow"]) == ["slow", "3"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  var names: List[str] = []
  var vals: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = keys[i]
    let v = copy values[i]
    if k == "mode"
      mode = copy v
    else
      if k == "level"
        level = copy v
      else
        var found = False
        for j in range(0, names.len())
          if names[j] == k
            vals[j] = copy v
            found = True
            break
        if found == False
          names.append(copy k)
          vals.append(copy v)
  var out: List[str] = [mode, level]
  for x in vals
    out.append(copy x)
  out
